About

I'm a Mechatronics Engineering graduate from Yıldız Technical University, specialising in systems and project engineering. My work sits at the intersection of mechanical design, electronics, and software — applied across defence, automotive, and research contexts.

At Baykar Technology, I contributed to weapon systems projects within the Project Management Unit, focusing on safety-critical documentation and cross-functional team coordination. At Ford Otosan, I worked with the Brake Modulation Team on ABS, EBD, and traction control validation as a part-time engineer.

Outside of industry, I led a TÜBİTAK-funded research project on electromagnetic braking systems, and designed avionics for the Yıldız Rocket Team during my first year of university.
